g.inkscape:label: Guides (locked)

text.font-family: Martian Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Menlo, monospace

g.text: A new townsperson for the Townsfolk rig, in the idle pose. Draw S, W and N; SW and NW are optional. I mirror the other three directions.
1 Draw each part as one closed shape in its group on the Drawing layer. Reshape or replace the dashed starter shape.
2 Keep both ends of a part over its joint dots. To change proportions, unlock the Skeleton layer and move the dots with your shapes.
3 Left limbs are enough: I mirror them. Draw both if the sides differ.
4 Cyan dashed groups are optional pieces. Anything in a group marked "swings" will hang and swing on Verlet points.
5 Face, buttons and seams are open lines inside the part they sit on. Faces show only in the views that can see them.
6 Fill in the Notes, save as SVG, and send it back.
200 px = 1 m · reference body 1.78 m · pivot (amber cross) = ground under the hips · camera 8° above the horizon, matching the sprite sheets
group name and the joints it spans
cyan dashed hints, delete any you don't use
hangs from the pelvis; its hem swings
held in the left hand, e.g. lantern or cane
eyes and mouth as open lines

g.inkscape:label: Drawing: one group per view, one group per part
